summary.text: Ikaika Hussey is a Democratic member of the Hawaii House of Representatives, District 29, who took office on November 5, 2024, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. He is vice president of development at Shake Energy Collaborative.

paragraphs.text: Ikaika Hussey earned both a bachelor's and a graduate degree from the University of Hawaii at Manoa, and his career experience includes working as vice president of development at Shake Energy Collaborative.
He succeeded May Mizuno in District 29.
For 2025-2026 he is vice chair of the Economic Development and Technology Committee and serves on the Finance and Tourism committees.
He defeated John Mizuno in the August 8, 2026 Democratic primary by 1,398 votes to 1,361, and faces Republican Tess Abalos in the general election.
